thread:
maria_support: customer (Acme) opened a Sev2 — multiple regions reporting p99 latency ~3-4x baseline since ~01:05 UTC. They pasted traces and said it started after kernel + cuda driver bump on our eu-west-2 nodes.
leo_infra: looking at node fleet, I see a deployment window at 00:58 UTC that rolled kernel 5.19.xx + driver 535.43 -> many nodes updated in eu-west-2 zone-b.
jamal_sre: confirmed p95/p99 graphs. p50 is fine, p95 ~1.8x, p99 ~3.5x. Spike aligns with the rollout.
tasha_runtime: can you share latency histogram and tail traces from freya-api for the affected instances? want to see if it's IO tail or CUDA stall.
maria_support: pasted minimal snippets from customer (sanitized):
```
Request 1: 180ms -> 720ms
Request 2: 170ms -> 680ms
Kernel logs: repeated block_device timeout warnings around 01:00
NVidia: GPU watchdog reset events: 01:02:12
```
leo_infra: host kernel shows increased host-wake up latencies and an uptick in IO wait. NVMe queue depth saturated on some blades. Could be hostfs+driver interaction with new kernel scheduler.
jamal_sre: I've kicked off a quick cluster query: `sum by(node) (rate(nvme_io_time_ms_count[5m]))` — a few nodes in eu-west-2-b spike correlated with customer-serving replicas.
tasha_runtime: runtime traces show long stalls on model forward when fetching KV cache from disk for cold prefixes. KV cache hits dropped 12%. That suggests host IO interference causing GPU wait.
leo_infra: possible culprits: new kernel I/O scheduling defaults + driver/firmware combo. There's also a minor CUDA runtime message that hints at longer memcpy times.
maria_support: customer asking for immediate mitigation, wants SLA protection. What's the short-term mitigation?
jamal_sre: mitigation options (fast):
- route customer traffic to unaffected AZ/replicas (eu-west-1 / dedicated fallback)
- cordon/evict noisy nodes and move pods to reserved hosts
- rollback kernel on a small canary set if we see quick improvements
- throttle background maintenance IO on affected nodes (less immediate)
I can implement routing fallback now if approvals clear.
leo_infra: I can cordon the top 6 noisy nodes and kick pods to warm nodes in eu-west-2-a that didn't roll. that'll reduce surface area. Doing it incrementally.
deploy-bot: deploy started: `route-policy apply --service freya-api --policy=eu-west2-fallback --dry-run=false`
jamal_sre: added a temporary route to dedicated-pool-3 for Acme and a small percentage (5%) of general realtime traffic to soak test.
tasha_runtime: added KV cache sticky-annotation to ensure replicas with hot cache keep serving (reduces cold-cache penalty).
leo_infra: cordon+drain in progress: nodes n-euw2b-12, n-euw2b-13 locked and drained. Observing metrics.
jamal_sre: after draining two nodes, p99 dropped ~30% for Acme. Good signal.
maria_support: replied to customer: we’ve routed you to an unaffected zone and are rolling mitigations; will keep them updated.
akshay_sales: customer flagged potential escalations to CSM if SLO breach. we should prioritize communication.
leo_infra: next steps:
1) finish draining noisy nodes (incremental, watch p99)
2) keep rollout paused for remaining eu-west-2 hosts pending root cause
3) reproduce on a staging cluster with the same kernel+driver combo and perf-run the KV cache workload
4) if reproducible, either patch driver/firmware or rollback kernel on fleet (prefer targeted rollback)

jamal_sre: for RCA data capture: collect per-node `iostat -x 1 20`, `nvme top`, `dmesg | tail -n 200`, `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` and full runtime traces for 5 affected requests.
tasha_runtime: I'll prepare a small repro that stresses KV cache eviction + cold prefix access and run it on a staging node with driver 535.43 + kernel 5.19 to confirm.
leo_infra: can someone from eng-runtime approve a fleet rollback or should we open a driver/firmware ticket with NVidia first?
jamal_sre: short-term: prefer targeted node replacement/eviction + routing fallback. Longer-term: reproduce and then decide rollback vs driver/firmware patch.
maria_support: customer is OK with migration for now but asked for ETA on permanent fix. I'll promise update in 4 hours and give daily status until resolved.
akshay_sales: flagged to CSM and legal for SLA watch.
leo_infra: pausing eu-west-2 rollout. Alerting: set `alert: kernel-driver-eu-west2-p99` to p95>2x for 10m.
jamal_sre: logging action items in the incident doc. will follow up with a short postmortem once root cause determined. :thumbsup:
